title: Day 799: Three Killed, Homes Shot and a Vehicle Torched in Culiacán
detail: On September 29, 2026, gunmen killed two brick-factory workers (one identified as Juan Carlos 'N') in the Los Mezcales neighborhood north of Culiacán and wounded Manuel 'N', 42. A male body in advanced decomposition was found near the Alturas del Sur subdivision, Alejandro 'N', 45, was shot by motorcycle-riding attackers in El Vallado Viejo, and a house in Juntas de Humaya was fired on and a vehicle in its garage set ablaze; an elderly woman and two minors inside escaped unharmed.

title: Five Homicides Recorded in Culiacán and Mazatlán on September 29
detail: Milenio's daily count lists five homicides in Sinaloa on September 29, 2026: three in Culiacán (a man beaten to death in the Chulavista sector, a man shot in El Vallado Viejo, and one dead and two wounded in the 5 de Febrero neighborhood, with one person detained) and two in Mazatlán (Infonavit Playas and Flores Magón). Sinaloa matched Baja California's toll among 36 national homicides that day.
